description: Over-to-over variation reference for modern men's T20. Holds the historical over-level distribution targets the zero-mean over-volatility effect is calibrated against, plus the fitted effect parameters. The effect widens the simulated runs-per-over spread to match history without changing the average over score.

targets._note: Modern-T20 (IPL/international, ~2016+) over-level aggregates. Values are published-aggregate anchors, not counted in this environment: Cricsheet raw JSON is not reachable from the build sandbox (the proxy blocks cricsheet.org), so these are documented targets with the uncertainty that implies. Regenerate exact counts offline with: python -m tools.build_realism_reference cricsheet --zip <t20s_json.zip> --over-stats
targets.sample_note: Ranges reflect ground/season variation; treat as a plausible band, not a point target.

fitted._note: Fitted so the simulated runs-per-over SD matches the target band with a zero innings-mean impact (verified paired on identical seeds). sigma is the SD of the per-over conditional run-mean shift in runs per legal ball; the effect tilts the over's run outcomes to base_mean + sigma*z with the max-entropy solver, so E over z leaves the innings total unchanged.

measured_effect._note: Measured in this repo, 120 matches x 2 innings on an Even pitch (seeds 5000-5119), realism engine. Before = over-volatility off, after = on.
